about_the_game:
Show you mean business out on the wild roads of Alaska with the Alaskan Road Truckers: Mother Truckers DLC (requires the base game, Alaskan Road Truckers, in order to play.)

This exclusive offer lets you show off your badass style with a brand new character as well as upgrading your truck’s look, letting every other driver know they need to get out of your way when they see you coming. Conquer the Alaskan frontier with unique cosmetics for your truck, after all, you’re an Alaskan Mother Trucker - make sure everyone knows it!

  • Here’s what you’ll get in the Alaskan Road Truckers: Mother Truckers DLC:
  • Some Badass Dude with Tats
  • Flaming Hot Truck Decals
  • The Horniest Hood Ornaments in Alaska
  • The Cattle-Killer 5000 Grill
  • Climate Changer Exhaust
  • The Ultra Deluxe Cab Light Set

Become a legendary Mother Trucker and hit the road like the badass you are with the Alaskan Road Truckers: Mother Truckers DLC.

About Alaskan Road Truckers:

Get ready for the ultimate trucking experience in the Last Frontier. In this heart-pounding simulation game, you'll step into the boots of a rugged Alaskan trucker and take on the most challenging and breathtaking roads on the planet.

Explore the Wilds of Alaska
Embark on an epic journey through the stunning Alaskan landscape, from snow-capped mountains to dense forests and icy fjords. Navigate treacherous terrain, unpredictable weather, and wildlife encounters while hauling your precious cargo.

Build Your Trucking Empire
Start with a humble rig and work your way up to become the kingpin of Alaskan trucking. Invest in new vehicles, upgrade your fleet, and expand your business to conquer new routes and challenges.

Master the Art of Trucking
Learn the ropes of professional trucking as you transport various types of cargo, from heavy machinery to fragile goods. Maneuver through narrow mountain passes, cross icy rivers, and tackle steep inclines. Your skills will be put to the test!

Don't miss out on the exclusive Mother Trucker DLC! This offer includes a unique player skin, truck skin, and customizations for your truck. Show off your style as you conquer the Alaskan frontier in your own way. Act now, and become a legendary Mother Trucker today!
